title: Kevin O'Neill
description: "Animal-like machines fascinate me," admits Kevin O'Neill. "And if they dwarf humans, I'm in (cyber) hog heaven." The London-born O'Neill worked with Pat Mills and Kelvin Gosnell in creating England's famed 2000 A.D. WEEKLY back in 1976. He left a couple of years later to go freelance. Notable credits include: RO-BUSTERS, GREEN LANTERN CORPS., METALZOIC, MARSHALL LAW, LEGENDS OF THE DARK KNIGHT (Bat Mite!), LOBO CONVENTION SPECIAL and PINHEAD VS. MARSHALL LAW.
